summary: The team is executing a two-track push: finalizing the Knowledge website redesign while simultaneously driving visibility for Asia Star and the new Intelligent China program, with immediate attention needed on the Intelligent China webpage launch and several time-sensitive event and content deadlines.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the Knowledge website redesign: after reviewing two homepage concepts, the team has decided to combine the best elements—keeping the two-menu structure, integrating the BCI/BSI indices banner, and adopting article detail page improvements—with Joseph to share the HTML and a working session needed to finalize feedback before Joker implements changes. In parallel, the global marketing strategy has sharpened its focus on Asia Star and Intelligent China as the top two programs for visibility and lead generation, with US partner programs (Berkeley, Stanford, Columbia) treated as secondary; the immediate task is launching the Intelligent China webpage and driving traffic, while Joseph profiles Asia Star participants and CRM hot leads. This week also demands urgent action on the November 13 European Chamber event—Shengjia and Graeme must step up targeted outreach to senior executives—and on finalizing the Sino-Swiss Economic Forum cooperation report email, plus publishing the Q3 2026 English Business Sentiment Index once approved. Looking ahead, the team must resolve the Outlook account lockout, kick off the Muck Rack invoice, review Flow's 2026 report and plan 2027 website/SEM with Gontran, and consider Development Reimagined for China-Africa speakers when planning next year's events after WIL.
